cells.quote:
Non-additive genetic influences, parental influences, and passive rGE could be dropped from all three PA baseline models without producing a significant decline in fit.
Under all PA models the parent-offspring correlation for EA was entirely genetically mediated.
cells.note: The nonsignificant result is coded ns because the text does not report an equivalence test or adequate-power analysis.

O.outcome_detail: structural-model fit for educational-attainment variance decomposition

result.effect: PA ASTE had the lowest AIC and BIC overall

cells.quote: In general, SH models fit the data slightly worse than our PA models; however, our SH baseline model which assumed no non-additive genetic influence fit the data marginally better than PA models which assumed no sibling effects (see AIC and BIC values in Table 4). Our best-fitting model overall, reporting both the lowest Akaike ’s Information Criterion and lowest Bayesian Information Criterion 43,44, was the PA ASTE model where A = 51% (46–56%), S = 10% (0.1 –18%), T = 16% (8 –26%), and E = 23% (21–26%).
cells.note: The direction reflects model-fit criteria, with lower AIC and BIC indicating better fit; the overall best-fitting model was PA ASTE.
